resolve_toolset: resolve a toolset name to its full list of tool names including composed toolsets
create_custom_toolset: create a custom toolset at runtime with a name, description, direct tools, and included toolsets
get_toolset_info: get detailed information about a toolset including resolved tools and tool count
validate_toolset: check if a toolset name is valid including special aliases like all and star
get_all_toolsets: get all available toolsets with their definitions including plugin-registered ones
